name: joplin_lookup_ingredient_quantity
intent: Find the quantity of an ingredient in a recipe in the Joplin app
description: Search for a named recipe in the Joplin app, open the recipe note, and read the amount and unit listed for a specified ingredient.
patterns: What quantity of an ingredient do I need for a recipe?
How much of an ingredient is in a recipe?
Find the amount of an ingredient in a Joplin recipe
Check an ingredient quantity in a recipe

inputs.name: recipe_name
inputs.description: The name of the recipe to look up.

inputs.name: ingredient_name
inputs.description: The ingredient whose quantity is needed.

steps.intent: Tap Search to find a recipe
Tap the {{recipe_name}} recipe in the search results to open it and read the quantity of {{ingredient_name}}
